user_stories.story: As a Risk Manager, I want to maintain a Risk Register, so that I can track potential threats to the organization.
acceptance_criteria: Risks have Impact and Likelihood scores.

user_stories.story: As a Risk Manager, I want to visualize risks on a heatmap, so that I can prioritize mitigation efforts.
As a Risk Manager, I want to link Risks to Controls, so that I can see how we are mitigating them.
acceptance_criteria: Manager can link a Risk to one or more Controls.
Residual risk is calculated based on control effectiveness.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want a Risk Dashboard, so that I can see my assigned risks and pending assessments.
